mechanism: The existing SQL availability function still validates durable release, profile state and proof expiry before host checks.

FileAvailable then loads the exact release scanner reference under the same tenant/partner RLS and non-owner runtime role, validates its immutable current definition and checks the protected local configuration hash.
Every new ID/path download and every bounded read on an already-open revision reader uses that guard. Missing, changed or loosely protected configuration returns no bytes.
This check never contacts the daemon. Later socket outage alone preserves a still-fresh completed snapshot; changed configuration, expiry and revocation block future availability.
No schema, migration, default permission, isolation, lease, scan deadline or publication assertion is relaxed.
The explicit real-engine harness validates exact ownership/caps before action and stops only its task runtime on completion/failure; ordinary core gates do not start an engine.
